content: Wasanama aintana punti kamana Isu untiye
Pigoya, kotu awamori Isu to kamana ukena pogini, uwoma kina'mi aeti kanama a'ya'ma ampa aki puguna, uwa marisa atate wanipisa karebi kotupi umintogini, a'ya'ma kina kotu awamori mintantawe.
Mintuguna aeba uwoma meto kamana uwaimintana, ka maya kamana uwaimintiye:
Abiyo. Ka yagarama aintana pikena wantiye.
Aeba wamagina aintanawapa maema aibarase pogana, aowa ka'isaba kepi tumpa waiyogana, kabarankama irosa'ma ampa nawaegaintiye.
Pigoya aowa ka'isaba yabankama nkabobori uwaena manto waintometa tunkwaima, karu'ena irantiye.
Piya pogana, abu'wapa kampa mabintiba tuminta, yaba nkabobori ara'waiyogana, pa taogana aeba karu'ena asama pari puma pu'wantiye.
Pigoya, to ka'isa aowapa kabubinti tunkaima iraogana, pi yoninkama aibarusa pogana asa wantiye.
Pigoya to ka'isaba apa mabi tumpa waima i'ma anosama aosa pama, ka'isa 30-wa, to ka'isa 60-wa, to ka'isa 100-wa suma aboraogana, uwoma ntaninta waintantiyema, uwaimintiye.
Uwaimintana: Ageyaga kina'maba ma kamana abibebe peno, Isu piya untiye.
Isu meto kamana agowa uwaimintiye
Pigoya, pi a'ya'ma kina atate wagasuguni, nagisarisa tara tumpaema kina'wake to aokinake meto kamana yomeka abigauguna,
maya uwaimintiye: Tigeba Koti kabiratakibintanagaba ago urimikenaba piye, uwaimite: Uwa kina'mikaba kana amiyo kamana naeba uwaimogini,
pigoya Aisaya pai kaemarantisa puma iba mayaenaba pewe:
Isu piya uwaimintiye.
Aintana punti kamana agowa Isu uwaimintiye
Piya uwaimintana, to kamana maya uwaimintiye: Tigeba ma meto kamanapa kampa abintawo. Aya pumabaya a'ya'ma meto kamana agowapa abikibewe.
Pigoya, pi aintana punti ntagara aintana aibarase puntisa puma, aogi kamanapa aibarase piye.
Piya, kepi tumintisa puma aogi kamana ke'i aibarase pogini, pi ka'isa kina'mi abepa, kewama karu'ena kanamapa, intabaipintisa aintana kanta puma wainti kamanapa ampaeriye.

Piya, ka'isa yabata tumima abu'wa kampa pantaisa pumaba, ka'isa kina'miba pewe: Aogi kamana abima maru'ena i'mu puma, arontaganto aogima miyegina, aintiba kana kamanatakaba antara'ena aboraginabe ata potakenaena aboraginabe, karu'ena uwa ataye.
Pigoya, toba piya puma kabubinti tumintisa puma, ka'isa kina'maba maru'ena aogi kamana abima,
aintiba mampabisaenaga napima, kotaka ibugagina tonarona maekenaga napiyegana, kana kamanapa agora kaka waye.

Pigoya, to ka'isa aogi mabi tumima tabera irantisa puma, to ka'isa kina'miba kana aogi kamanapa abima aega'ma miyewe. Piya, aintanaba ka'isa 30-wa, ka'isa 60-wa, to ka'isa 100-wa suma, aborantisa puma, wasanaba tonarona aogiyenaba Kotiti potawe, uwaimintiye.
Igi'maete kampa kaka atakena kamana Isu untiye
Uwaimintana to mayama ibigantiye: Pigoya, wasanama kane yaku igi'maete namapinti wamaba, aeba kankabe maema aibarakitakibe, waikena sipa amentapinti metakibe, yara itagikibayawe, a.
We, kampa agantintanaba agorapa kampa kaka wantiye. Toganaba kanewama e'wasa pisa puma meto kamana'ama nkagowapa aborakiye. Airari kaenta'enaba toganaba aborawaekiye.
Ageyaga kina'maba abeno, uwaimintiye.
Uwaimintana to kamana maya uwaimintiye: Pi abe kamana aogima abima tigebi ataiyo. Abimagiri tigeba wasana pabi aborawaimikibe nkawameta Kotiba a'wae puma timikiye.
Pigoya, wasanama ka'isa agowapa aogima napikibipa, uwoma to agoba Kotiba omikiye. Pigoya to yagarama kamana agowa kampa napikibipa, abikenaenawapa Koti maegaikiye, piya uwaimintiye.
Aintana iranema meto kamana Isu untiye
Uwaimintana Isu to maya uwaimintiye: Pigoya, Kotiba mayama taepa kabirataye: Wasanama yogari wama, aintana pugaitegina,
asi nasi asekapa waimarate, arapa asima uma agateginaba: Aya pumabaya kana aintanaba i'ma anosakiyema, napiye.
Piya, aewa mabintisa i'ma a'yenka aboraurite ima, aosaba pama anontana pegina,
pi ntagaba yogari wama naninta umaeye. Pigoya nanintara kabiyisa puma Kotiba piyama tagutapa kabirataye, untiye.
Ya a'wa meto kamana Isu untiye
Piya untana Isu to maya untiye: Pigoya, Koti kabiratamisa puma nanawe ukune. Pikaba ayama meto kamanapa ukunema, ibigantana:
Pigoya, masiteti yawama nkaowapa uwaenantonto waintakana maema aintana pukibipa,
pipisa i'ma anosama tabe ya ima, amaba tabera wagana kana pegina, kabarankamaba amari inapa kiyewe. Pintana piya pemisa puma Kotiba piyamakabirataye, uwaimintiye.
Meto kamana'waka Isu kamana untiye

Pigoya, uwoma meto kamanatasa aogi kamana'wapa uma ige abikena kamana uwaimogini abima napiyuguna, toma toma meto kamana a'ya'ma kina uwaimitegina, togana abagi kina'wa ibiwaipa meto kamana a'ya'ma agowapa uwaimintiye.
Pontawama Isu nkawamu wasintiye
Pigoya, pi ntaga ase yogana: Ta'ema maroteri wakune, uwaimitegina,
Isu wanipisa karebi mima, awamori mintume kinapa itaogini, abagi kina'mi wanipisa karebi ababute wauguni, to wanipisa karebi ka'isa kinapa aege wantawe.
Piya puguna, agasiya ponta kanama wanipa tabera aiga'yo'ya puma, ka'isa wanipa wanipisa karebinti iyogana, kunta puma ipirintakena puntiye.
Isu a'no aisagenawata waitamintogini, igeba aeti wama abage pumagini maya omintawe: Tisa yagara, kaeba taekaba kampa napiyeno. Taeba naisukena pune, omintawe.
Piya omuguna, aeba asimagina pontawamakaba tabe kamana umagina, waninkamaba: Pasebuma, uwa waiyo yogana, ponta a'ya waogana wanipa uwasuwa puntiye.
Aibogana maya uwaimintiye: Nanaga tiyekuruba pewe. Timititi'enaba kampa waintiya, a, untiye.
Piya yogini, igeba pami pumagini: Aeba nana yagaragana, pontawamabe waninkamabe ae kamana wasiyesema, igeba mare-u me-u puntawe.
